description: The price in credits of rewriting one message by AI (mode). Free; answers result_id, expected_revision and `credits` for rewrite_message. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/outreach/leads/{cid}/steps/{step_id}/rewrite/quote]

generation_id.description: The outreach generation id (get_outreach campaign.generation.id); omitted: the current one.

mode.description: other_hook (another fact), shorter, warmer, rewrite (with the note).

step_id.description: The step id of the message (get_outreach_lead steps[].step_id).

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

name: quote_message_rewrite
title: Price of an AI rewrite
